messages:
anya: quick sync — ACME is pushing for a private deployment with reserved throughput in June. need to map who owns runtime changes, infra slots, and the security gating. can we sketch a minimal plan here?

mike_p: I can own runtime changes (kernel selection + batching profiles). need expected qps/seq-length distribution and target p95 to size.

carlos: infra heads up: we currently have 2 reserved GPU slots flagged for enterprise trials week-of June 9. If ACME needs steady 200 rps sustained, we likely need +1 GPU and a prewarm window.

dena: launch criteria from product: 1) p95 latency <100ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens) 2) throughput >= 150 rps steady 3) audit log streaming to customer's SIEM 4) canary with 5 customers before GA.

rachel: security: HSM/KMS integration is required and we need an architecture review + pen test. estimate ~3 weeks for review + remediation. also need documented data flow for logs.

mike_p: noted re p95. on batching: we can change continuous-batching window to 20ms for this customer to favor latency, but that reduces throughput efficiency. will prototype and bench by next Tue.

carlos: proposal: allocate `private-june-1` cluster (2 GPUs) + burst slot `private-june-burst` (+1 GPU) for peak. prewarm policy: `prewarm: true, window: 30m`

sec-team: please file the architecture review in the security queue. pinging @rachel on ownership.

infra-bot: reminder — cluster `private-june-1` currently free windows: Jun 10-14, Jun 17-21. Use `infra reserve` to claim.

dena: can we compress the security path? if pen test is blocking, can we ship a limited feature set (no log forwarding) to satisfy early trials?
rachel: yes we can scope a reduced data-plane: no SIEM streaming initially, only internal audit logs + customer access to stored artifacts. that reduces attack surface and shortens pen test time. still need KMS/HSM notes.

mike_p: for rollout sequence I propose: dev perf bench -> canary on `private-june-1` -> A/B canary (50/50) with fallback to hosted model -> GA. will add a short checklist.

carlos: ops constraints: we need ticket in infra backlog for capacity change and a runbook for failover (route to hosted) — I can draft.

anya: actions: 1) mike_p: bench + checklist by Tue 2) carlos: open infra ticket + draft failover runbook by Fri 3) rachel: file arch review + confirm pen-test scope by EoW 4) dena: update roadmap entry and customer comms draft by Thu. I'll add these tasks to the initiative card and tag owners.

anya: also — small config snippet I'll include in the card for clarity:

"""
reserved:
  cluster: private-june-1
  gpus: 2
  burst: private-june-burst
  prewarm: true
  prewarm_window: 30m
"""

carlos: ack. I'll claim the reserve after ticket.

dena: ACK, I'll soften the comms: "limited features during trial" and call out when SIEM will be enabled.

mike_p: one more ask — we need a small prompt set for QA to validate quality after quantization/kv-cache changes. can product provide ~30 representative prompts?

dena: on it, will share by EOD tomorrow.

anya: thanks everyone. i'll put this thread summary into the initiative card and set a checkpoint meeting next Mon. :thumbsup:
